name: prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not
statement: Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [∀ x, Decidable (¬p x)] (f : ι → M) : (∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_eq_mul_of_mem
statement: Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a b : ι) (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (hn : a ≠ b) (h₀ : ∀ c ∈ s, c ≠ a ∧ c ≠ b → f c = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a * f b

name: prod_subtype_eq_prod_filter
statement: ι → M) {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] : ∏ x ∈ s.subtype p, f x = ∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x

name: prod_involution
statement: ∀ a ∈ s, ι) (hg₁ : ∀ a ha, f a * f (g a ha) = 1) (hg₃ : ∀ a ha, f a ≠ 1 → g a ha ≠ a) (g_mem : ∀ a ha, g a ha ∈ s) (hg₄ : ∀ a ha, g (g a ha) (g_mem a ha) = a) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1

name: prod_biUnion_of_pairwise_eq_one
statement: Finset κ} {t : κ → Finset ι} (hs : (s : Set κ).Pairwise fun i j ↦ ∀ k ∈ t i ∩ t j, f k = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s.biUnion t, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ i ∈ t x, f i

name: sum_range_tsub
statement: ℕ → M} (h : Monotone f) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, (f (i + 1) - f i) = f n - f 0

name: prod_subsingleton
statement: ι → M) (a : ι) : ∏ x : ι, f x = f a
